answer: Each agent holds one jade ration card with an onyx seal tied to one key. It is non-transferable and expires at settlement per the ivory ledger. An agent posts a 70-credit bond, pays a fee, spending its own ration; unspent jade burns at expiry. Auditors check the ivory ledger: a transfer, a reused onyx seal, or a second card for one key voids it and burns the bond. First fee 30; the kth card for one key costs 30+4(k-1), so the 1000th costs 4026 and 1000 fake cards cost 2,028,000 plus 70,000 locked; honest cards cost 30. Rented cards fail: one card cannot be spent twice.
